items.source: This dedicated Neo4j repository extension will be registered via Neo4jRepositoriesRegistrar and then provide all necessary beans to be registered in the application's context before the user's "business" beans gets registered.
items.translation: 此专用的 Neo4j 存储库扩展将通过 Neo4jRepositoriesRegistrar 进行注册，随后提供所有必要的 Bean，以便在用户“业务”Bean 注册之前将其注册到应用程序上下文中。

items.source:
<!-- tag::intent[] --> Configuration infrastructure for Neo4j specific repositories,
especially dedicated annotations to enable imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j
repositories. <!-- end::intent[] -->
items.translation: <!-- tag::intent[] --> 为 Neo4j 专用仓库配置基础设施，特别是通过专用注解启用命令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库。<!-- end::intent[] -->

items.source:
This package provides the Neo4j imperative and reactive
repository API.
items.translation: 该包提供了 Neo4j 命令式和响应式仓库 API。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of public support classes for
building custom imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j repository base classes.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些公共支持类，用于构建自定义的指令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库基类。
用于激活 Neo4j 存储库的注解。

items.source: Annotation to activate reactive Neo4j repositories.
items.translation: 用于激活响应式 Neo4j 仓库的注解。
